---
title: "1. Loading the data"
format: html
---

Reads the three study files from `data-raw/`, exactly as the original code did; only their names and location changed. Each read checks the columns later steps use, so a changed file stops the run instead of being misread.

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/load_data.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/load_data.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/functions.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/load_data.R")
```

## Files present

Stops, naming the missing file, if any of the three study files is not in `data-raw/`.

```{r}
#| label: check-data-files
#| eval: false
```

## Organ offers

One row per offer from a donor with HIV to one of the center's candidates, from the metrics the center submitted to UNOS, with the OPTN refusal code recorded for each declined offer.

```{r}
#| label: read-organ-offers
#| eval: false
```

## Candidates

One row per candidate who consented to the center's HOPE listing, with the dates of consent, end of follow-up and transplant, and whether the candidate was transplanted and whether from a donor with HIV. Column types are given by position, as in the original, so the step checks that the three date columns were read as dates.

```{r}
#| label: read-subjects
#| eval: false
```
